accept_invitation_required: An invited user becomes active by accepting the invitation — resend the invitation instead.
access_window_closed: Your access to this business is not open at this time ({{window}}).
already_revoked: This connected account has already been disconnected.
not_active: Only an active user can be suspended.
passkey_key_not_accepted: This passkey’s key does not meet our security requirements. Use another authenticator.
passkey_not_verified: The passkey could not be verified. Please try again.
use_deactivate_endpoint: A user is deactivated through the deactivation step, which hands over what they still own.
photo_not_an_image: The photo must be a PNG or JPEG image.
photo_too_large: The photo is too large — at most 5 MB.
ui_translation_blank: A UI string is never blank.
ui_translation_placeholders_changed: The text must keep the placeholders of the shipped text.
bank_account_used_by_location: A location uses this account as its own bank account. Remove the override on the location first.
closure_period_inverted: The closure ends before it starts.
last_active_location: A business always keeps at least one active location. Activate or create another one first.
location_address_incomplete: An address needs street, number, postal code and locality.
location_canton_not_swiss: The canton applies to a Swiss address only.
location_canton_required: A Swiss address needs its canton.
location_code_immutable: A location's code is fixed once saved – documents and marketplaces carry it.
location_code_taken: Another location of this business already has this code.
location_geo_incomplete: Latitude and longitude go together – enter or clear both.
location_inactive: Nobody can be newly assigned to a deactivated location.
location_postal_code_invalid: This postal code does not fit the address's country.
unknown_bank_account: This bank account does not belong to this business.
unknown_holiday_calendar: This holiday calendar does not exist.
year_out_of_range: This year lies outside the calendar.
logo_format_jpeg: JPEG is not accepted for a logo: it has no transparency, so it prints with a grey box behind it on every document. Upload an SVG (preferred) or a PNG.
logo_format_unsupported: A logo must be an SVG (preferred) or a PNG file.
logo_too_small: This PNG is {{width, number}} × {{height, number}} px. A logo printed 50 mm wide needs roughly {{min, number}} px on its long edge to stay sharp at 300 dpi — upload a larger PNG, or an SVG, which is sharp at any size.
logo_dimensions_too_large: The image is larger than {{max, number}} px on its long edge — more than any document needs.
logo_file_too_large: The logo file is too large — at most 5 MB.
logo_png_damaged: The PNG file is damaged and cannot be read.
logo_svg_invalid: The SVG file is not a well-formed SVG document.
logo_svg_entities: The SVG declares XML entities, which can be used to attack the systems that read it. Export the logo again without a DTD.
standard_text_placeholder_unresolved: A standard text contains a placeholder that has no value here ({{placeholders}}). Add the information or adapt the text under Administration › Standard texts.
standard_text_placeholder_invalid: The text uses placeholders that are not allowed here ({{placeholders}}).
standard_text_exists: This text already exists in this language. Edit the existing one.
standard_text_category_mismatch: This text belongs to another category.
standard_text_code_unknown: This standard text does not exist.
standard_text_code_target_mismatch: This text is used in another place.
standard_text_target_unknown: This category has no texts for this use.
standard_text_slot_unknown: This position does not exist here.
standard_text_target_required: Choose where and in which position the text is used.
standard_text_template_whatsapp_only: Template approval applies to WhatsApp texts only.
standard_text_template_id_required: An approved WhatsApp template needs the provider's template ID.
standard_text_not_an_override: Only an adapted standard text has a template to review.
standard_text_seed_language_missing: This template does not exist in this language.
standard_text_seed_not_shipped: Nexotec ships no text for this seed; there is nothing to restore.
logo_too_many_pixels: This PNG is {{width, number}} × {{height, number}} px — more than {{max, number}} megapixels. No logo needs that many: a whole A4 page at 300 dpi has barely 9, and every document carrying the logo would have to load them all. Scale the image down, or upload an SVG.
number_pattern_invalid: The pattern is not valid: exactly one {counter:N} (N from 1 to 9), {year} and {location_code} at most once, otherwise only letters, digits and - / . _
number_pattern_too_long: A number following this pattern would be longer than 16 characters.
number_pattern_location_unavailable: This document type does not know its location yet; its pattern cannot use {location_code}.
number_pattern_location_code_missing: No location of your business has a code for {location_code}. Record a location code first.
number_pattern_reset_needs_year: A range that starts again every year needs {year} in its pattern — otherwise a number would be handed out twice.
number_range_start_out_of_range: The start value does not fit the counter's digits.
number_range_frozen: This number range has handed out numbers already and is frozen. Only Nexotec support can still change it.
number_range_reason_required: A change to a frozen number range needs a reason.
number_range_exhausted: The number range has no number left for its counter's digits. Please contact support.
number_location_code_missing: This number range prints the location code, and the document names no location with a code.
number_range_counter_too_short: This pattern's counter has too few digits for the range's next number. Choose more digits for {counter:N}.
contact_group_inactive: Nexotec has withdrawn this contact group; it cannot be switched on.
support_session_already_open: End the running support session first.
support_session_ended: This support session has already ended.
support_target_platform_admin: A support session cannot be started for a Nexotec platform administrator.
support_target_platform_tenant: A support session cannot be started for an account of the Nexotec platform.
platform_admin_outside_platform_tenant: Platform administration is given only to a Nexotec platform account. Create the account there.
platform_tenant_holds_staff_only: The Nexotec platform holds platform administrator accounts only.
platform_group_holds_no_dealer: The Nexotec group is reserved for the platform. Choose another group.
platform_tenant_holds_no_entitlements: The Nexotec platform holds no modules.
support_target_self: You cannot start a support session for yourself.
support_target_not_active: A support session is only possible for an active user.
setting_location_inactive: A deactivated location's setting cannot be changed.
setting_value_above_maximum: The value is above the maximum allowed.
setting_value_below_minimum: The value is below the minimum allowed.
setting_value_language: A translation can only be in German, French, Italian or English.
setting_value_no_longer_valid: This earlier value no longer fits the setting and cannot be restored.
setting_value_not_a_choice: Choose one of the values offered.
setting_value_not_a_divisor: The value must divide {{divides}} without remainder.
setting_value_not_a_switch: This setting is a switch: on or off.
setting_value_text_length: The text cannot be empty and has at most 500 characters.
setting_value_too_many_decimals: The value has too many decimal places.
setting_value_wrong_field: The value does not match this setting's kind.
setting_choice_requires_setting: This choice needs another setting first, for example the work units per hour. Set it, then choose again.
setting_required_by_choice: Another setting needs this one, for example time in work units. It cannot be cleared while that one applies.
setting_no_longer_divides_setting: «{{multipleOf}}» must divide «{{setting}}» without remainder. Change «{{setting}}» first.
labour_category_member_exists: This person is already in this labour category.
labour_category_user_cannot_act_here: Only someone who works in this business can be allocated to one of its labour categories.
labour_rate_agreement_end_has_no_amount: The end of an agreement has no amount.
labour_rate_agreement_exists_on_date: An agreement of this contact and category already starts or ends on that date.
labour_rate_agreement_in_use: An agreement that already applies is never changed. Enter a new rate or its end from a later date.
labour_rate_agreement_nothing_to_end: There is no agreement of this contact and category before that date to end.
labour_rate_amount_invalid: An hourly rate is an amount above zero with at most four decimals.
labour_rate_category_name_language: A translation is possible in German, French, Italian or English only.
labour_rate_category_name_length: A labour category's name has 1 to 100 characters.
labour_rate_category_name_taken: The business already has a labour category of this name.
labour_rate_entry_basis_changed: The business now enters labour rates differently (net or with VAT). Reload and enter the rate again.
labour_rate_exists_on_date: This category already has a rate from that date at this location.
labour_rate_in_use: A rate that already applies is never changed. Enter a new rate from a later date.
labour_rate_location_inactive: A deactivated location gets no new rate.
labour_rate_starts_in_the_past: A new rate starts today or later. A rate that already applies is never changed.
labour_rates_entry_basis_not_set: First set whether the business enters labour rates net or with VAT.
labour_rate_agreement_contact_merged: This contact was merged into another one. Choose the contact that remains.
